products.name: Challenge Proxy
products.tagline: Cryptographic challenge protection for any endpoint
products.description: Stop bots and unauthorized clients before they reach your origin. Challenge Proxy issues cryptographically signed challenges that are easy for browsers and native apps to solve, but expensive for attackers to scale.
products.summary: Cryptographic challenge protection that sits in front of any API or web endpoint.
products.keyBenefit: Block abuse without CAPTCHAs or rate-limit gymnastics.
benefits: Eliminate credential stuffing and scraping at the edge
Preserve user experience with no visible friction
Reduce origin load during traffic spikes
Comply with fraud and abuse SLAs
useCases: Protecting high-value login and checkout flows
Preventing ticket scalping and inventory abuse

products.name: Google WAA API
products.tagline: BotGuard attestation tokens for YouTube and Gemini
products.description: A production-grade API for generating Google Web Attestation tokens. Solves real BotGuard challenges via residential proxies and returns tokens verified against YouTube and Gemini in real time.
products.summary: Server-side BotGuard attestation for YouTube and Gemini.
products.keyBenefit: Get tokens that work on the first try, every time.
features: Real BotGuard challenge execution via residential proxies
Verified against YouTube player API and Gemini endpoint
benefits: Tokens accepted on first request — verified in CI
Handles proxy rotation and cookie management
Drop-in SDK or plain HTTP API
